deprecate_function: deprecate the deprecate function to warn about deprecated arguments and extract their values
remap_transformers_class: remap deprecated transformers class names to their newer replacements based on version checks
handle_deprecated_kwargs: handle deprecated keyword arguments by extracting values and issuing FutureWarning messages
validate_deprecation_version: validate that deprecated arguments are not past their removal version in the current diffusers release
check_transformers_version: check the installed transformers version to determine if a class remapping should apply
